answer: Mechanism: Operator Namespace Quarantine (ONQ). Each agent registers under a control-plane-attested operator namespace; the economy links agents by operational signals—yarrow (clock-skew drift), tide (egress burst correlation), and sparrow (control-plane handshake reuse). A detected sybil cluster triggers namespace-wide throttling, dispatch-priority revocation, and forced re-attestation for every agent under that operator, not wallet penalties. Cost: attackers must provision separate control planes, egress, and timing profiles; repeated clusters accumulate namespace debt and longer quarantine.
